name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 8 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 29 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2025-08-28, at wavelengths from 0.95 to 3.75 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
